title: DataSketches restores the quantiles of a queried sketch
summary: The parent changed the median from b to c and exposed six entries after a four-item round trip. The fixed heap and wrapped readers returned four ordered values, weights 1 through 4, median b and rank-0.55 value c.

change.description: Issue #756 reports median c after restoration versus b before restoration on the faulty code. On the merge expect [a,b,c,d], cumulative weights [1,2,3,4], median b and rank-0.55 quantile c.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.

The parent changed the median from b to c and exposed six entries after a four-item round trip. The fixed heap and wrapped readers returned four ordered values, weights 1 through 4, median b and rank-0.55 value c.
